articles.title: 'She never tried to mould us’: Kajol reveals the biggest gift Tanuja gave her
articles.description: Kajol shared insights about her mother's liberal parenting style during an appearance on a chat show. Tanuja never imposed restrictions or expectations on her children, allowing them to explore their interests freely. articles.title: Bigg Boss 11 fame Sapna Choudhary files for divorce from husband after 6 years of marriage. Haryanvi singer shares her perspective on love: ‘Men are more practical’
articles.description: Sapna Choudhary has officially decided to file for divorce from her husband, Veer Sahu, after six years of marriage. The couple, who tied the knot privately in 2020, share two children, Porus and Shah. In her recent interview, she opened up about the struggles of losing her own identity in the relationship and alluded to infidelity.

articles.title: Koi Mil Gaya Actor Anuj Pandit Sharma Marries Dr Prabhjyot Chawla
articles.description: Actor Anuj Pandit Sharma, known for Koi... Mil Gaya, has married Dr. Prabhjyot Chawla in an intimate ceremony. The wedding featured a blend of Hindu and Sikh rituals, with the couple sharing joyful glimpses of their celebration on social media.

articles.title: Travis Kelce matches Justin Bieber’s signature look at his latest Chiefs vs. Cardinals game in Kansas City
articles.description: In a striking Justin Bieber-inspired ensemble, Travis Kelce wowed fans during the Kansas City Chiefs face-off against the Arizona Cardinals while his wife Taylor Swift offered her support from the stands. Scoring his second touchdown, Kelce helped secure a 24-7 advantage for his team. The couple, newly married following a heartfelt ceremony at Madison Square Garden, shared precious moments with family during the game.
